slots.role: opener: the chore as a picture
slots.visualRecipe: Near-black ground. A 3x2 grid of dark rounded cards, hairline borders, about 90% of the frame, one card per destination the audience juggles. Each card receives rough text rows and a small red or amber warning chip naming a different problem. End state: each card outlined in red or amber.
slots.motionRecipe: Cards appear on a 1-2 frame stagger over the first 9 frames. A pointer visits the cards in reading order; a chip lands under each roughly each half second. Slow push-in of about 14% over 3.4 s, power1.out. Last 5 frames: all outlines pulse. Hard cut out on the hit.
slots.soundRecipe: Music at a steady tempo starting on frame 0; optional small UI ticks as each chip lands. The cut out falls 2-3 frames ahead of a hit.

copySlot.purpose: one short label per warning chip, each a different concrete obstacle

slots.role: positioning sentence, then the first request and its reply
slots.visualRecipe: Warm cream ground. One centred serif sentence in sentence case, text-box height about 11% of the frame and width about 70%, at mid-height. A dark rounded message bubble at top right (x 0.61-0.92, y 0.11) and a reply bubble at bottom left (x 0.17-0.46, y 0.78), each carrying a small avatar and sender name. End state: sentence and both bubbles on screen.
slots.motionRecipe: First frame empty; word groups fade in place over 3 frames each, 6 frames apart, no reflow. Slow push-in of about 6% across the slot, sine.inOut. At +0.76 s the request bubble fades in and its text types at about two words a second; at +4.36 s the reply bubble rises over 5 frames (power2.out) and streams a word each 2 frames.
slots.soundRecipe: Music continues; optional soft key ticks under the typing. The slot is 12 beats; the cut out lands 2-3 frames ahead of a hit.

copySlot.purpose: the category the product claims, then a natural one-sentence request and a short confident reply

slots.visualRecipe: Charcoal ground. The new film's own mark assembles at centre (about 18% of frame width, y about 0.40): two simple shapes joined by a drawn stroke. A two-word status label in white sans under it; a small attribution chip at bottom left. End state: the mark complete, its stroke still travelling.
slots.motionRecipe: Frame 1: a dot. Frames 2-8: shapes grow and the stroke draws on; the label builds word by word, 4 frames apart. The stroke keeps looping until the cut. Exactly 4 beats.
slots.soundRecipe: Music only; no effect needed. Cuts in and out land 2-3 frames ahead of hits.

copySlot.purpose: what the assistant is doing right now

slots.role: proof: one input turns into many tailored outputs
slots.visualRecipe: Cream ground, faint square grid. One source card at centre top and a two-row serif caption under it (text boxes about 8% of height). Then a 3x2 grid of white cards, each shaped for its destination, about 85% of frame width, carrying small green check chips. A dark pill notification at bottom centre (y 0.86-0.90). A small terracotta named pointer flag moves among the cards.
slots.motionRecipe: Source card fades and scales in over 4 frames; caption rows fade in 5 frames apart. At +1.73 s the caption fades over 3 frames, the source dissolves and the new cards spring out of its position about 4 frames apart, scaling up starting near 0.3 on an overshooting ease-out. Check chips appear in pointer order; at +4.17 s the notification rises over 5 frames (power2.out) and holds.
slots.soundRecipe: Music; the burst sits on a hit. Optional soft pops per card. The slot is 12 beats.

copySlot.purpose: a caption stating the transformation in plain words, then a notification giving a count and a moment

slots.role: benefit sentence, then a larger request
slots.visualRecipe: Same cream card as the first ask: a two-row centred serif benefit (text boxes about 8-10% of height) and a single request bubble at top right.
slots.motionRecipe: Empty first frame, rows fade in place over 3 frames, a slow push-in of about 4% (sine.out). The request bubble appears at about +0.9 s and types at about two words a second.
slots.soundRecipe: Music continues; 8 beats; cut out 2-3 frames ahead of a hit.

copySlot.purpose: a concrete, relatable saving of effort, then a request that widens the scope

slots.visualRecipe: Identical to the first interstitial; only the status label changes.
slots.motionRecipe: Identical to the first interstitial, 4 beats.

copySlot.purpose: what the assistant is doing for the larger request

slots.visualRecipe: A planning board on light cream: columns, rows, a header holding a counter pill. Small coloured items populate it, plus one larger accent-coloured hero item. End state after the pull-out: the entire board inside a rounded panel, about 4% cream margin.
slots.motionRecipe: Board fades in over 2 frames; a named pointer flag places items each 4-6 frames while the view drifts right about 16% of a frame width and in about 4%, linear, for 2.4 s. At +2.77 s a pull-out of about 1.2x to 1.0x, expo.out over about 15 frames; the counter keeps climbing; hold to the cut.
slots.soundRecipe: Music; the pull-out starts on a hit. Optional soft ticks as items land. 12 beats.

copySlot.purpose: item labels inside the board and a running total in the header

slots.visualRecipe: Near-black ground; one centred column of two message bubbles about 38% of frame width: the user's request on top, the assistant's reply under it carrying three small status chips.
slots.motionRecipe: Request bubble rises and settles in about 7 frames on an overshooting ease-out. At +1.86 s the reply enters underneath and both shift up over about 6 frames (power1.out); chips appear 1 s afterwards.
slots.soundRecipe: Music; the reply lands on a beat. 8 beats.

copySlot.purpose: a one-sentence request for an immediate action and a two-sentence confirmation

slots.role: summary claim acted out as an edit
slots.visualRecipe: Cream ground, one centred serif sentence, text-box height 11-12% of the frame, 74-85% of width. The first word is the variable: ahead of each change it sits in a pale blue selection under a small terracotta caret flag.
slots.motionRecipe: Empty first frame, sentence fades in over 3 frames. At intervals of 55 frames (one group of 4 beats) the selected word is deleted and its replacement types at one letter a frame while the sentence recentres on each frame. Three variants in total, matching the three requests shown.
slots.soundRecipe: Music; each change lands 1-2 frames ahead of a hit.

copySlot.purpose: one fixed sentence whose first word cycles through the three actions the film demonstrated

slots.visualRecipe: Cream ground, the new film's own mark and wordmark centred (about 36% of width), one small sans row under it giving the category and address. Final frames black.
slots.motionRecipe: One empty frame, then the mark fades and scales up starting near 85%, about 8% overshoot, settling in about 12 frames. Hold about 2 s. Fade to black over 13 frames at about 39.5 s; last 3 frames black.
slots.soundRecipe: Music resolves; near-silence after about 38.6 s.

rhythm.cutGrid: Each shot lasts 4, 8 or 12 beats (55, 111 or 166 frames at 30 fps): 8, 12, 4, 12, 8, 4, 12, 8, 12, then a 3.1 s end card. Hard cuts only, each placed 2-3 frames ahead of the loudness peak of a hit. Light and dark grounds alternate around each interstitial. Accents inside the summary come at 4-beat intervals.

style: Warm cream editorial cards in a book serif, dark charcoal interstitials and replica interfaces as proof; two accents (one for the assistant, one for the partner mark), flat fills, soft card shadows, no texture.

keep: A wordless problem picture first: many small failures in a grid, escalating, then a hard cut to a calm light card
The three-step loop: request on a light card, a 4-beat dark interstitial, the result on a light interface
Escalating proofs: one into many, then many at scale, then instant, no wait
Fast machine streaming against slow human typing in the message bubbles
The one-to-many burst out of a single origin on a 4-frame stagger
Populate a board at a near framing, then pull out on a fast-out ease to show it entire
Summary as an on-screen edit of one word, 4 beats apart
Shot lengths in multiples of 4 beats, cuts 2-3 frames ahead of the hit, no transition effects
Empty first frame on each light card, then a 3-frame fade in place
mustChange: branding: mark, wordmark, partner mark, accent colours tied to either brand, attribution chip
music: a new licensed track; rebuild the beat grid for it
graphics: each interface must be the new product's real interface or a faithful capture, never the reference's screens
copy: each sentence, request, reply, label, chip and handle
the example customer and their content
the destinations shown and their icons
